messages:
Ethan Moore: Noticed duplicated inference calls from the Next App Router LlamaIndex starter when deployed to Edge (Vercel). Single user request -> two outgoing requests recorded in telemetry.
Ethan Moore: Quick repro: deploy starter, hit /api/ssr-chat, watch outgoing requests in dev console / telemetry.
Ethan Moore: Server snippet from starter (app/api/chat/route.js):
```js
export const runtime = 'edge'
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
export async function POST(req) {
  const { q } = await req.json()
  const resp = await client.chat.create({ model: 'rw-llama-7b', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: q }] })
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(resp))
}
```
Sana Iqbal: Any transport logs? Could be transport retry + SDK retry.
Ethan Moore: Logs show fetch polyfill retried on 429 then SDK retried again. Example lines: 
[2026-04-02T08:45:10Z] transport: fetch error (retrying)
[2026-04-02T08:45:10Z] sdk: retry attempt=2
Diego Ramos: That matches a double-submit pattern. Short-term: set explicit Idempotency-Key or pass autoIdempotency: true in server contexts.
Sana Iqbal: We should avoid changing browser behavior. JS SDK should detect server/edge runtime and auto-add Idempotency-Key by default there. Python SDK already does this.
Ethan Moore: Verified: sending header 'Idempotency-Key' reduces calls to one in telemetry.
Diego Ramos: I'll open an SDK issue and a PR to the starter templates to add a server-safe example. Also adding a CI harness test that simulates transport-level retry and asserts only one upstream call.
devex-bot: Issue created: platform#2187 "Next App Router starter: Edge SSR duplicate requests due to transport+sdk retry" assigned to @Diego Ramos
Sana Iqbal: Docs TODO: quickstart/server-runtimes.md with guidance on idempotency and retries. Also update eval harness to dedupe by idempotency keys to avoid noisy regressions.
Ethan Moore: Thanks — I'll update my forked starter README with the workaround and re-open PR once SDK changes land. :thumbsup:
